about_the_game:
LiveCap — Your Voice, Heard by Everyone

Imagine This

  • Late-night gaming stream. "What did you say?" comments flow in from overseas, but you just keep speaking your native language. Automatically translated subtitles appear on screen, and viewers worldwide are captivated by your gameplay.

  • International meetup in VRChat. When you speak in your language, subtitles automatically appear in the Chatbox in English. Your international friends understand your words and smile. Language barriers? They don't exist anymore.

  • One-hour gaming commentary video. What used to take three hours for subtitles is now just drag & drop. You're using the saved time to brainstorm your next video idea.

This is daily life with LiveCap.

🎮 A Subtitle Tool Built for Gamers and Streamers

LiveCap brings together cutting-edge open-source AI technology in a form everyone can use. Choose from 6 speech recognition engines published by NVIDIA, MistralAI, OpenAI, and others to find the perfect fit for your needs. Everything runs on your PC with no monthly fees ever.

Why Streamers Choose LiveCap

"My hands are full with the controller during streams" → Speech recognition automatically creates subtitles. Viewers never miss your reactions.

"I want to connect with international viewers but my English..." → Real-time translation breaks down language barriers. Just speak in your preferred language.

"Subtitles for highlight videos are such a pain" → Just drop your video file for complete SRT subtitles. Upload directly to YouTube.

"I want to interact with people speaking other languages in VRChat" → Your spoken words appear as subtitles in the Chatbox via OSC. Real-time translation bridges language gaps.

🚀 Pro-Level Streaming Setup in 3 Minutes

1. Install and Launch

No complicated initial setup. Just launch and select your microphone.

2. Choose Your Engine

NVIDIA Parakeet for English, Whisper S2T for multilingual. Not sure? Let "Auto" mode handle it.

3. You're Ready

Add browser source in OBS, enable OSC in VRChat. That's it—your streaming just leveled up.

🎯 6 AI Engines to Choose From — Find Your Perfect Match

For English Excellence

  • NVIDIA Parakeet v3 - WER 6.05% accuracy, professional transcription level

  • Whisper S2T - OpenAI technology handles various English accents

For Japanese Streaming

  • NVIDIA Parakeet JA - Trained on 35,000 hours of Japanese speech

  • ReazonSpeech - Lightweight and fast, runs smoothly on lower-spec PCs

For Multilingual Communities

  • MistralAI Voxtral - Auto-detects 8 languages, strong European language support

  • NVIDIA Canary - High accuracy for English, German, French, Spanish

🎨 Freedom to Express Your Style

For OBS Streaming

  • Complete control over fonts, colors, size, position

  • Fine-tune outlines, shadows, background opacity

  • WebSocket integration with other tools

For VRChat

  • Your spoken words display in Chatbox via OSC

  • Real-time translation for multilingual communication

  • Speak in your language, others see translated subtitles

For Video Editing

  • Supports major formats: MP4, MKV, MOV

  • Batch process multiple files at once

  • Accurate subtitle generation with timestamps

💪 Why We're Committed to Local Processing

Your voice belongs to you.

Unlike cloud services, LiveCap runs all speech recognition processing on your PC. Your audio data is never sent externally*. Your streaming conversations and VRChat chats—your privacy is protected.

*Only when using translation features is text data sent to translation APIs (audio data is never sent)

Plus:

  • Ultra-low latency - No network delays, real-time processing

  • Completely free - No monthly fees, no character limits

  • Offline capable - Works without internet (after initial model download) *Translation requires network connection

⚙️ Technical Specifications

Supported Formats

  • Audio Input: All Windows audio devices

  • Video: MP4, MKV, MOV, AVI, WebM, FLV

  • Audio: WAV, MP3, M4A, AAC, OGG, FLAC, WMA

  • Output: SRT, TXT, WebSocket JSON

System Requirements

Minimum Requirements

  • Windows 10/11 (64-bit)

  • Intel Core i5 8th gen / AMD Ryzen 5 3600

  • 8GB RAM

  • 10GB Storage

Recommended Requirements

  • Intel Core i7 10th gen / AMD Ryzen 7 5700

  • 16GB RAM

  • NVIDIA GPU (even faster with CUDA support)

⚠️ Before You Buy

Please test with the free trial version. The trial has a 3-minute limit but includes all features. Confirm it works perfectly in your environment before purchasing the full version.

🌟 Join Our Community

LiveCap grows through our community of streamers and gamers. Your feedback might shape the next update.

Discord: Questions, feature requests, bug reports

Break through language barriers. Connect with the world.

With LiveCap, your voice reaches everyone.
